newsitem.title: USA: D.I.Y. Home Q4 shr increases.
newsitem.headline: D.I.Y. Home Q4 shr increases.

text.p: (Dollar amounts in thousands except share data)
For The Three Months Ended For The Fiscal Year Ended

NOTE - On December 31, 1995, the company adopted a change in accounting for inventories from the last-in, first-out method to the first-in, first-out method. As required by generally accepted accounting principles, the company has retroactively adjusted prior years' financial statements for this change. The effect of the change in accounting method decreased net income and earnings per share as previously reported, for the three months ended December 30, 1995, by $55,700 and $0.01, respectively, and net income as previously reported for the fiscal year ended December 30, 1995 increased by $13,300. The effect of the change in accounting method did not affect earnings per share as previously reported for the fiscal year ended December 30, 1995.
